One year and nothing else done here. 
Please look over this as it is about account security and should in fact be in a priority list.

Had a friend that recently lost their account, yes it’s bad password practice, but could have been prevented or made more difficult with 2FA
ONLY TOOK A YEAR GUYS, FINALLY IN PROGRESS
@{5c5b528c3f9e073ff97f986d|full_name}: Actually, a year and a half. But who's counting?
At this point, 2FA has rolled out to all users! We'll be working to improve it over time. Here's a link to the docs for setup instructions: https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/setup-2fa

details:
I strongly recommend implementing standard TOTP-based Two Factor Authentication, usable with apps like Google Authenticator and Authy. Passwords alone are weak security in the modern world. Having two factor authentication gives the peace of mind, to those want it, that your account is secure even if the password is discovered.

In addition, it should become a requirement that all VRChat moderators and developers enable two-factor authentication on their accounts.
title: Two Factor Authentication for VRChat Accounts
